name: clean-code
description: Senior-engineer discipline for coding agents: write without AI slop and without security holes, rewrite existing code into the shape a senior would have written (one path, or the whole repo slice by slice with a commit per slice), hunt and fix bugs red-test-first, make tests able to fail, finish a change before committing (interrogate, deslop, test audit, audit, gates, fresh-context review), and install lint gates plus hooks that make it automatic. Every skill ends with a short analytics report.
